prose.subject: Payment Required: Stanmere Logistics API Report
prose.body: Your request for the Stanmere Logistics analytics report is ready for processing. To unlock full access, please complete the payment of 1609.80 USDC. This fee covers the comprehensive data set, including route efficiency metrics, cargo integrity logs, and real-time telemetry summaries for the selected period. Once the transaction is confirmed, the report will be generated and made available for immediate download. All payments are securely directed to the account 0x9d1bac1b9a2431c152d28de6b27a65e08b3be3e2. Please ensure the exact amount is sent to avoid processing delays. Upon successful receipt, our system will automatically verify the transfer and release the requested documentation. If you encounter any issues during the payment process, refer to the technical support section of the API portal for assistance. Thank you for using Stanmere Logistics.
